1059239264303.descriptionHtml:
The BodyJ4You 156PC Body Piercing Kit is a body jewelry and tools set with 140 pieces of assorted 14G and 16G surgical stainless steel jewelry plus 10 individually sterilized hollow needles, 2 clamps, 2 latex gloves and 2 alcohol pads.

Key Facts

  • Product type: Body piercing kit with jewelry and single-use tools
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Total pieces: 156
  • Jewelry: 140 pieces: 20 basic pieces plus 120 randomly selected pieces
  • Gauges: 14G and 16G jewelry; needles in 14G and 16G
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel, high polished; listed as hypoallergenic
  • Jewelry types: Ball closure rings, circular horseshoe barbells, curved barbells, straight barbells, labret studs, hoops, beads
  • Sterilization: Needles individually sterilized with ethylene oxide (EO) gas
  • Colors available: Silvertone, Rainbow, Black, Goldtone, Rose Goldtone

What's Included

  • 140 pieces of assorted body jewelry (20 basic plus 120 random hoops, rings, studs, beads and barbells)
  • 10 hollow piercing needles, 14G and 16G, individually sterilized
  • 2 disposable clamps
  • 2 latex gloves
  • 2 alcohol pads

Variants

  • Silvertone: random 14G and 16G jewelry in silvertone
  • Rainbow: random 14G and 16G jewelry in rainbow
  • Black: random 14G and 16G jewelry in black
  • Goldtone: random 14G and 16G jewelry in goldtone
  • Rose Goldtone: random 14G and 16G jewelry in rose goldtone

Features

  • Jewelry and tools together in one 156-piece set
  • Surgical stainless steel is durable, holds its color and wipes clean easily
  • High polished smooth surface for everyday, all-day wear
  • Hygienic single-use tools for prepping and wiping the area
  • Lightweight jewelry made for beginners and experienced piercers
  • Each kit is quality checked

Use Cases

  • Belly button and navel jewelry
  • Nose and septum jewelry
  • Tragus, ear cartilage, helix and industrial jewelry
  • Eyebrow, lip and tongue jewelry
  • Nipple jewelry
  • Stocking up on spare 14G and 16G body jewelry

Care and Safety

Needles, clamps, gloves and alcohol pads are single-use. The surgical steel jewelry wipes clean easily. BodyJ4You piercing aftercare products are sold separately for new piercings.

Frequently Asked Questions

What comes in the BodyJ4You 156PC Body Piercing Kit?

The kit includes 140 pieces of body jewelry, 10 sterilized hollow needles in 14G and 16G, 2 disposable clamps, 2 latex gloves and 2 alcohol pads, for 156 pieces in total.

What gauge is the jewelry?

The jewelry in the BodyJ4You 156PC kit is assorted 14G and 16G.

Is the jewelry random?

Partly. The 156PC kit has 20 pieces of basic jewelry plus 120 randomly selected hoops, rings, studs, beads and barbells.

What is the jewelry made of?

The jewelry is surgical stainless steel with a high polished surface, listed as hypoallergenic, durable and easy to wipe clean.

How are the needles packaged?

The 10 hollow needles in the BodyJ4You 156PC kit are individually sterilized with ethylene oxide (EO) gas and meant for single use.

Which body areas is the jewelry for?

The assortment covers belly button, nose, septum, tragus, ear cartilage, helix, industrial, eyebrow, lip, tongue and nipple jewelry.

How does it compare with the BodyJ4You 36PC PRO kit?

The 156PC kit has 140 jewelry pieces, most of them random, while the 36PC PRO kit has a fixed list of 20 jewelry pieces with tools.

12135240516.descriptionHtml:
The BodyJ4You 120PC Body Piercing Jewelry Kit is a value pack of 120 randomly selected surgical stainless steel body jewelry pieces in standard sizes for ear, facial and body piercings, in 14G, 16G and 18G.

Key Facts

  • Product type: Body piercing jewelry assortment (jewelry only)
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Count: 120 pieces
  • Selection: Random; colors may vary from the photo
  • Gauges: 14G, 16G, 18G
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel, high polished
  • Jewelry types: Captive bead rings, rings, barbells, curved bars, studs and screws
  • Packaging: Each jewelry type packed in a sealed zip-lock bag
  • Condition: Brand new, unused

What's Included

  • 120 randomly selected body jewelry pieces in standard gauges and lengths, sorted by type in sealed zip-lock bags
  • No needles or tools are listed for this kit

Features

  • 120 pieces covering ear, facial and body piercings
  • Standard gauges and lengths used by most piercers
  • Surgical stainless steel is durable, keeps its color and is easy to clean
  • High polished smooth surface for daily wear
  • Sorted packaging with one sealed bag per jewelry type

Use Cases

  • Ear jewelry: earlobe, tragus, conch, daith, helix, cartilage, orbital, industrial, rook, antitragus, snug
  • Facial jewelry: eyebrow, bridge, cheek, eyelid, lip, labret, Medusa and snake bites
  • Nose, septum and nostril jewelry
  • Tongue and smiley jewelry
  • Navel, nipple, nape and corset jewelry
  • Stocking a mix of spare body jewelry

Care and Safety

Surgical stainless steel is easy to clean. Every body is different, and piercers may use other lengths and gauges than the standard sizes in this kit.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is in the BodyJ4You 120PC Body Piercing Jewelry Kit?

The kit contains 120 randomly selected pieces of surgical stainless steel body jewelry, such as rings, barbells, curved bars and studs, sorted by type in sealed zip-lock bags.

Does the 120PC kit include needles or tools?

No tools are listed for the BodyJ4You 120PC kit; it is a jewelry assortment. The BodyJ4You 36PC PRO and 156PC kits include needles, clamps and gloves.

What gauges are included?

The BodyJ4You 120PC kit includes jewelry in 14G, 16G and 18G, in standard lengths.

Can I choose the colors or styles?

No. Each 120PC set is randomly selected, and colors may vary from the picture.

Will the sizes fit my piercing?

The kit uses standard gauges and lengths, but every body is unique and your piercer may use a different length or gauge.

What is the jewelry made of?

The jewelry is high polished surgical stainless steel that is durable, keeps its color and is easy to clean.

All items arrive brand new, unused and sterilized with EO gas; clamps are disposable. The surgical steel jewelry is easy to clean.

What jewelry is in the BodyJ4You 36PC PRO kit?

The BodyJ4You 36PC PRO kit has 20 jewelry pieces: 2 ball closure rings, 6 horseshoe barbells, 4 curved barbells, 6 labret studs and 2 straight barbells, in 14G and 16G.

It includes piercing needles, 2 disposable clamps, 2 black latex gloves and alcohol cleaning pads, all brand new and sterilized with ethylene oxide (EO) gas.

Is the jewelry random?

How is it different from the BodyJ4You 156PC kit?

6558385995823.descriptionHtml:
The BodyJ4You 3PC 16G Flat Back Stud Set is a set of three internally threaded 316L surgical stainless steel flat back studs with cubic zirconia tops, in bar lengths 6mm, 8mm and 10mm, for cartilage, tragus, helix, conch, labret, lip, Monroe and Medusa piercings.

Key Facts

  • Product type: Flat back stud earring and labret set
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Pieces: 3 studs
  • Gauge: 16G (1.2mm)
  • Bar lengths: 6mm (1/4 inch), 8mm (5/16 inch), 10mm (3/8 inch)
  • CZ sizes: 2mm, 3mm, 4mm
  • Material: 316L surgical stainless steel, tarnish resistant; listed as hypoallergenic
  • Closure: Internally threaded screw top with flat back
  • Options: 13 metal, CZ color and shape combinations

What's Included

  • 3 flat back studs, one each in 6mm, 8mm and 10mm bar length, with 2mm, 3mm and 4mm CZ tops

Variants

  • Silvertone, Clear CZ
  • Goldtone, Clear CZ
  • Rose Goldtone, Clear CZ
  • Black Steel, Clear CZ
  • Rainbow Steel, Clear CZ
  • Goldtone, Yellow CZ
  • Rose Goldtone, Pink CZ
  • Black Steel, Black CZ
  • Blue Steel, Blue CZ
  • Silvertone, Threadless: silvertone set listed as threadless
  • Clear, Aurora, Vitrail: three CZ colors, clear, aurora and vitrail
  • Silvertone, Black, Goldtone: three-color mix
  • Star, Heart, Round CZ: three CZ shapes, star, heart and round

Features

  • Flat back sits smooth against skin without catching hair or clothing
  • Internally threaded top holds each stud secure so it will not loosen
  • Three bar lengths in one set to mix across ear and face piercings
  • 316L surgical stainless steel resists tarnishing
  • Lightweight for all-day comfort; quality checked before shipping

How to Use

Insert the flat back post from behind, place the CZ top on the front and turn clockwise until snug. Use tweezers for a firm grip and avoid overtightening.

Use Cases

  • Cartilage and helix earring stack
  • Tragus and conch studs
  • Labret, lip, Monroe and Medusa studs
  • Lining studs along the lobe
  • Casual or active wear

Frequently Asked Questions

What sizes are in the BodyJ4You 3PC Flat Back Stud Set?

The set has three 16G (1.2mm) studs with bar lengths of 6mm, 8mm and 10mm and CZ tops of 2mm, 3mm and 4mm.

What material are the flat back studs?

The BodyJ4You flat back studs are 316L surgical stainless steel, listed as hypoallergenic and resistant to tarnishing.

Are these internally threaded?

Yes, the standard options use an internally threaded screw top. The Silvertone, Threadless option is listed as threadless.

Which piercings do they fit?

The BodyJ4You 3PC 16G studs are made for cartilage, tragus, helix, conch, labret, lip, Monroe and Medusa piercings.

How do I put the stud on?

Insert the flat back post from behind, place the CZ top on the front and turn clockwise until snug, using tweezers for grip and avoiding overtightening.

Which option should I choose?

Choose a single metal with clear CZ for a classic look, a matching color pair like Rose Goldtone with Pink CZ, or the Star, Heart, Round CZ option for mixed shapes.
